ValidationRule.description: Requests a reason if a story has been marked as out of scope, duplicate, or cancelled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT( $Setup.Org_Exceptions__c.Bypass_Validation_rules__c ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( PF_Story_Status__c , 'Out of Scope') ,ISPICKVAL( PF_Story_Status__c , 'Duplicate'),ISPICKVAL( PF_Story_Status__c , 'Canceled')) , ISBLANK( PF_Story_Status_Reason__c ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide a brief reason why the story has been marked out of scope, duplicate, or cancelled.
